scientific_integrity: The critical rational identities have an algebraic proof and an independently reproducible finite classification. No external scientific audit was conducted.
scientific_limitations: Uniqueness is established only through total census size six; no upper bound on reversals for arbitrary larger profiles is proved. The all-size family asserts two sign changes after deleting zeros, without locating the final adjacent crossing. Fixed known abundances and uniform random sampling are assumed.
title: Sampling design can reverse species-richness variance twice: a sharp six-individual threshold
